class.name: SteamProjectSettings
class.brief_description: Project settings affecting how GodotSteam functions internally.
class.description: These functions and properties affect how GodotSteam functions internally. Most of them deal with app IDs but also initialization processes, callbacks, and some debugging.

method.name: get_id_in_use
method.description: Returns the current app ID in use. This is based on the value of [member SteamProjectSettings.app_type].

members.member: The base app ID for a game or application on Steam.
The type of app this project is; one of the following possible types: application / game, demo, Steam playtest, or tool. GodotSteam will use the app ID for this type.
Initialize Steamworks early in the boot-up chain. Can fix Steam overlay issues when running the project from the editor for some people.
The app ID for a game or application's demo.
Whether or not to embed Steam callbacks to work automatically. If this is enabled, you do not need to call [method Steam.run_callbacks] in your code.
Whether or not to enable Steamworks debugging included API warning handling through [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUtils#SetWarningMessageHook] SetWarningMessageHook[/url].
The maximum number of channels to use with SteamPacketPeer.
The app ID for a game or application's Steam playtest.
The app ID for a game or application's tool such as level or workshop editors.
